creation: Jack may convert a deliberately discarded stored ability into an Ability Book.

default_rules.duplication: No duplication from one stored pattern without an explicit future mechanic.
default_rules.failed_incompatible_use: Book remains intact unless a separate effect explicitly damages it.
default_rules.slot_effect: Converting the stored ability to a book empties Jack's slot.

destroy: Destroys the stored pattern from Jack without redistribution.
release_to_system: Does not create a book; it enters the unresolved redistribution process.
